issues.description: CLOSED as accepted repo-wide convention in the delta re-audit. conanfile.py:58 keeps `url = ""  # CI fills this`. The submitter's convention claim is verified: the same literal is present in precedent recipes including archives/c/camlp-streams/5.0.1/conanfile.py:44, archives/o/ocaml/4.14.1.1.4/conanfile.py:24, and tmp copies for xmlm/topkg/nyancat/teseq, so the framework tolerates and fills this field. Residual note only: code-style rule 5 lists this exact string as a forbidden placeholder and two other precedents (unittestpp, mbrola) fill a real URL, so the rule text and practice are inconsistent; no action required for this PR.
issues.fix_suggestion: None required (accepted convention, non-blocking). Optionally set url = "https://github.com/ocaml/ocamlbuild" if maintainers later enforce code-style rule 5 uniformly.
